description: Per-player toggle for slime, honey, soul sand, ice, cobwebs and other movement effects (Fabric 1.21.11)

mods.name: StickyToggle
mods.description: Lets each player turn off how slime, honey, soul sand, ice, cobwebs, powder snow, berry bushes, water currents and bubble columns move them. Mobs, items and mechanics stay vanilla.

releases.notes:
StickyToggle for **Minecraft Java 1.21.11** (Fabric).

Each player can choose how slime and honey blocks affect their own movement:
- `/stickytoggle slime on|off`: bounce, walk slowdown, slipperiness
- `/stickytoggle honey on|off`: speed slowdown, jump reduction, wall slide
- `/stickytoggle all on|off`: slime and honey together

Works for every player, no op needed, and only changes the player who runs it. Fall damage, mobs, items and mechanics stay vanilla.

**Install on both server and client**, together with Fabric API (0.141.6+1.21.11) and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. Requires Java 21.

mods.name: StickyToggle
mods.description: Lets each player turn off how slime, honey, soul sand, ice, cobwebs, powder snow, berry bushes, water currents and bubble columns move them. Mobs, items and mechanics stay vanilla.

releases.notes:
StickyToggle for **Minecraft Java 1.21.11** (Fabric).

Each player can choose how these blocks affect their own movement:
- `/stickytoggle slime on|off`: bounce, walk slowdown, slipperiness
- `/stickytoggle honey on|off`: speed slowdown, jump reduction, wall slide
- `/stickytoggle soulsand|ice|cobweb|powdersnow|berrybush on|off`: slowdown or slipperiness
- `/stickytoggle water on|off`: water current push
- `/stickytoggle bubblecolumn on|off`: bubble column push and pull
- `/stickytoggle all on|off`: everything at once

With MaLiLib on the client: a menu (from Mod Menu or any MaLiLib config screen) with an ON/OFF button and an optional hotkey for every block and setting.

Works for every player, no op needed, and only changes the player who runs it. Fall damage and other damage, mobs, items and mechanics stay vanilla.

**Install on both server and client**, together with Fabric API (0.141.6+1.21.11) and Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer. Requires Java 21.
